hook: 25 miles out in Hurricane Helene, with his dog.
narration: This man and his dog were twenty-five miles out at sea, [short pause] in Hurricane Helene.
Their thirty-six-foot sailboat was disabled and taking on water.
A Coast Guard helicopter from Air Station Clearwater sent a rescue swimmer down to them.
He got the dog into the water, then the man, and hooked them both to the hoist.
outcome: The man and his dog both made it out, in good health.
title: Sinking in Hurricane Helene with his dog
description:
During Hurricane Helene on Sept. 26, 2024, a man and his dog were aboard a disabled 36-foot sailboat taking on water 25 miles off Sanibel Island, Florida. A Coast Guard Air Station Clearwater helicopter crew hoisted them both; they were reported in good health.

Footage: U.S. Coast Guard video by Petty Officer 2nd Class Hudson, edited by Lt. Cmdr. Kellerman, via DVIDS: https://www.dvidshub.net/video/938235
